chapterInfo.content:
102
Abooboo ne anidasoɔ
Mmɔborɔni a ne home te no a ɔyi n’abooboo gu AWURADE anim no mpaebɔ.
1Ao, AWURADE, tie me mpaebɔ,
na ma me sufrɛ nnuru w’anim.
2Nyi w’anim nhunta me,
da a me ho hia me no,
brɛ w’aso ase ma me,
da a mesu mefrɛ no, yɛ ntɛm gye me so.
3Na me nna hi sɛ wisie,
na me nnompe adɔ sɛ mmukyia.
4M’akoma abo na akusa sɛ ɛfan,
na m’ani apa m’aduane die so.
5 # Hiob 19.20 M’apinisie nne nti
me nnompe afemfam me wedeɛm.
6Mete sɛ ɛserɛ so nantwinoma,
mayɛ sɛ amamfo so patuo.
7Mesiri pɛ, mete sɛ apatuprɛ
a ɔno nko si ɛdan atifi.
8Da mu nyinaa m’atamfoɔ bɔ me ahohora,
wɔn a wɔbɔ me so dam de me yɛ ntanka.
9 # Dwom 80.5 Na madi nso sɛ aduane,
na mede esu mafra m’anonneɛ mu.
10Ɛnam w’abufuo ne w’anibereɛ so nti,
na womaa me soɔ, na woato me atwene.
11 # Dwom 90.5; Hiob 14.2 Me nna te sɛ sunsum a ɛretwam,
na me deɛ, mekusa sɛ ɛfan.
12Na wo, AWURADE deɛ, wowɔ hɔ daa,
na wo nkaeɛ kɔduru awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa so.
13 # Dwom 14.7 Wobɛsɔre abɛhunu Sion mmɔbɔ,
na ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wodom no ni,
na ɛberɛ no adu.
14Na wo nkoa wɔ n’aboɔ ho akoma,
na wɔn yam hyehye wɔn, ne mfuturo ho.
15Na amanaman bɛsuro AWURADE din,
na asase so ahemfo nyinaa asuro w’animuonyam,
16sɛ AWURADE akyekyere Sion,
wayi ne ho adi n’animuonyam mu,
17wadane n’ani akyerɛ onnibie mpaebɔ,
na wampo wɔn mpaebɔ.
18Wɔbɛtwerɛ yei ama nkyirimma,
na ɔman a wɔbɛbɔ wɔn no bɛyi AWURADE ayɛ,
19sɛ wafiri ne soro kronkron hɔ abrɛ n’ani ase ahwɛ fam,
AWURADE firi soro na ahwɛ asase,
20 # Dwom 79.11 sɛ ɔbɛtie apokyerɛfoɔ apinisie,
na wasane owuo mma,
21na wɔabɔ AWURADE din Sion,
na wɔaka n’ayeyie Yerusalem,
22 # Dwom 87.4 da a aman bɛbom aboaboa wɔn ho ano
ne ahennie, sɛ wɔbɛsom AWURADE.
23Wago me tumi mu ɔkwan mu,
watwa me nna so.
24 # Dwom 55.23 Meka sɛ: Me Nyankopɔn,
mmu me nna mu mfa me,
wo mfeɛ kyɛre
kɔduru awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa so.
25 # Heb 1.10-12; Dwom 90.2 Tete nteredee na wohyɛɛ asase aseɛ,
na ɔsoro ne wo nsa ano adwuma.
26 # 2 Pe 3.10 Ɛno deɛ, ɛbɛsɛe, na wo deɛ, wotim hɔ daa.
Wɔn nyinaa bɛsu sɛ atadeɛ,
wobɛsakyera wɔn sɛ atadeɛ, na wɔasakyera.
27 # Dwom 102.12 Na wone wo ara, na wo mfeɛ rensa da.
28 # 1 Yoh 2.17 Wo nkoa mma bɛtena ase,
na wɔn asefoɔ atim w’anim.

Ao, AWURADE, tie me mpaebɔ,
na ma me sufrɛ nnuru w’anim.
Nyi w’anim nhunta me,
da a me ho hia me no,
brɛ w’aso ase ma me,
da a mesu mefrɛ no, yɛ ntɛm gye me so.
Na me nna hi sɛ wisie,
na me nnompe adɔ sɛ mmukyia.
M’akoma abo na akusa sɛ ɛfan,
na m’ani apa m’aduane die so.
M’apinisie nne nti
me nnompe afemfam me wedeɛm.
Mete sɛ ɛserɛ so nantwinoma,
mayɛ sɛ amamfo so patuo.
Mesiri pɛ, mete sɛ apatuprɛ
a ɔno nko si ɛdan atifi.
Da mu nyinaa m’atamfoɔ bɔ me ahohora,
wɔn a wɔbɔ me so dam de me yɛ ntanka.
Na madi nso sɛ aduane,
na mede esu mafra m’anonneɛ mu.
Ɛnam w’abufuo ne w’anibereɛ so nti,
na womaa me soɔ, na woato me atwene.
Me nna te sɛ sunsum a ɛretwam,
na me deɛ, mekusa sɛ ɛfan.
Na wo, AWURADE deɛ, wowɔ hɔ daa,
na wo nkaeɛ kɔduru awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa so.
Wobɛsɔre abɛhunu Sion mmɔbɔ,
na ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ wodom no ni,
na ɛberɛ no adu.
Na wo nkoa wɔ n’aboɔ ho akoma,
na wɔn yam hyehye wɔn, ne mfuturo ho.
Na amanaman bɛsuro AWURADE din,
na asase so ahemfo nyinaa asuro w’animuonyam,
sɛ AWURADE akyekyere Sion,
wayi ne ho adi n’animuonyam mu,
wadane n’ani akyerɛ onnibie mpaebɔ,
na wampo wɔn mpaebɔ.
Wɔbɛtwerɛ yei ama nkyirimma,
na ɔman a wɔbɛbɔ wɔn no bɛyi AWURADE ayɛ,
sɛ wafiri ne soro kronkron hɔ abrɛ n’ani ase ahwɛ fam,
AWURADE firi soro na ahwɛ asase,
sɛ ɔbɛtie apokyerɛfoɔ apinisie,
na wasane owuo mma,
na wɔabɔ AWURADE din Sion,
na wɔaka n’ayeyie Yerusalem,
da a aman bɛbom aboaboa wɔn ho ano
ne ahennie, sɛ wɔbɛsom AWURADE.
Wago me tumi mu ɔkwan mu,
watwa me nna so.
Meka sɛ: Me Nyankopɔn,
mmu me nna mu mfa me,
wo mfeɛ kyɛre
kɔduru awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ nyinaa so.
Tete nteredee na wohyɛɛ asase aseɛ,
na ɔsoro ne wo nsa ano adwuma.
Ɛno deɛ, ɛbɛsɛe, na wo deɛ, wotim hɔ daa.
Wɔn nyinaa bɛsu sɛ atadeɛ,
wobɛsakyera wɔn sɛ atadeɛ, na wɔasakyera.
Na wone wo ara, na wo mfeɛ rensa da.
Wo nkoa mma bɛtena ase,
na wɔn asefoɔ atim w’anim.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
